data.action: 坐在深色长木椅上，身子微微倚靠在你的肩头，银色手指轻按泛黄书页，神色恬静安详
data.camera: medium close-up, cozy two-person intimacy, library dust motes floating in sunbeam
data.description: 【夕阳静谧的高穹图书馆】高达穹顶的老式木质图书馆内弥漫着古卷与墨汁的沉静清香。斜阳将巨大的落地窗棂投影在长木桌上。薇尔莉特与你并肩而坐共享一本厚厚的诗集。或许是因为看得入神，她那松散开的金色秀发轻轻倚靠在你的肩膀上，静静聆听着你均匀的心跳声。
data.lighting: 晚霞透过高耸彩绘玻璃投射的浓郁暖橙与古铜金斜射光
data.location: 莱顿大学皇家藏书馆一角
data.promptProse: Violet Evergarden sits beside her companion at the old library's long table, sharing a thick poetry book and gradually resting her loose blonde hair against his shoulder. Her simple white cotton dress and silver mechanical hands remain visible, with no hat. The close two-person view includes high wooden shelves and window mullions behind. Warm-orange stained-glass sunset crosses the pages and skirt edge, while their joined reading space casts soft shadows beneath the book.
data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 暮色藏书馆的肩头轻倚·「书里描绘的幸福，就像现在这样吗？」
